$comment: Checked-in OpenAPI documents that are generated from route modules, and the
command that generates them. Nothing regenerated-and-diffed them before, so
three PRs merged green with stale specs (voyant#4193, #4204, #4210).
A spec belongs here as soon as it is generated rather than hand-written.
Adding one costs a few seconds of check time; leaving one out costs a
published contract that silently stops describing the deployment.
